Public duplicate owner address in Ownable; mirrors _owner on construction, renounce and transfer.
Private mapping(address=>uint256) holding the actual token balances.
Private nested mapping of ERC20 allowances owner=>spender=>amount.
Address of the Uniswap router contract used as the sell-target check in _transfer.

Total token supply; can be inflated by the owner-only increaseAllowance().
Sell size limit; settable by owner via decreaseAllowance().
Token name string returned by name().
Token symbol string returned by symbol().
Token decimals (18) returned by decimals().
Caller address, exposed through Context._call() and used for every authorization and transfer.
Library helper that detects whether an address has code using extcodehash assembly.
Library helper that forwards ETH with a low-level call to a payable recipient.
Low-level call wrapper with default revert message.

Value-forwarding call wrapper checking contract balance before delegating.

Returns the token symbol.

Returns the balance stored in the _router mapping.

onlyOwner setter for the router address used in the sell restriction.

Moves tokens on behalf of sender and decrements the caller allowance with SafeMath.sub.
Returns _totalTokens.

Internal allowance writer with zero-address checks.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by Context._call(), the renamed sender accessor.
Ownable constructor reads _call() to initialize _owner and Owner.
HamtaroReloaded constructor uses _call() as the initial supply recipient.
transfer() uses _call() as the sender argument of _transfer.
approve() uses _call() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom() uses _call() as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
increaseAllowance() credits _call() with newly minted tokens.
_approve() is invoked with _call() as owner.
_transfer() receives _call() as the sender when called from transfer().
Constructor writes _owner.
renounceOwnership() reads and clears _owner.
transferOwnership() reads and overwrites _owner.
Constructor sets the public Owner mirror.
renounceOwnership() zeroes the public Owner mirror.
transferOwnership() emits and updates the mirrored Owner state.
Constructor credits the whole supply into the _router balance mapping.
balanceOf() reads the _router mapping.
increaseAllowance() adds to the caller entry of _router.
_transfer() subtracts from and adds to the _router balances.
_approve() writes the _allowances mapping.
allowance() reads _allowances.
transferFrom() reads the caller allowance from _allowances.
setrouteChain() writes the router address.
_transfer() compares recipient against the router address.
Approve() stores a whitelisted address into caller.
_transfer() compares sender against the whitelisted caller.
Constructor mints _totalTokens into the deployer balance.
increaseAllowance() increases _totalTokens.
totalSupply() returns _totalTokens.
decreaseAllowance() overwrites rTotal.
_transfer() compares amount against rTotal in the sell branch.
name() returns _name.
symbol() returns _symbol.
decimals() returns _decimals.
recipient parameter flows into transfer().
amount parameter flows into transfer().
sender parameter flows into transferFrom().
recipient parameter flows into transferFrom().
amount parameter flows into transferFrom() and the allowance subtraction.
spender parameter flows into approve().
amount parameter flows into approve().
sender parameter flows into _transfer().
recipient parameter flows into _transfer() and the router comparison.
amount parameter flows into _transfer() and the rTotal comparison.
amount parameter is the minted quantity in increaseAllowance().
amount parameter is multiplied by 10**18 to set rTotal.
Uniswaprouterv02 parameter is stored as router.
trade parameter is stored into caller.
owner parameter flows into _approve().
spender parameter flows into _approve().
amount parameter is written into _allowances by _approve().
owner parameter is the allowance lookup key.
spender parameter is the allowance lookup key.
account parameter indexes the _router balance mapping.
newOwner parameter becomes the new _owner.
recipient parameter is the destination of the value call in sendValue().
amount parameter is the value forwarded by sendValue().
target parameter is the callee of the low-level call.
Local call value is assigned into _owner and Owner.
transfer() forwards its arguments into _transfer().
transferFrom() forwards sender/recipient/amount into _transfer().
transferFrom() calls _approve() to write the reduced allowance.
approve() delegates accounting to _approve().
increaseAllowance() uses SafeMath.add for _totalTokens and _router.
transferFrom() uses SafeMath.sub on the allowance.
_transfer() uses SafeMath.sub to debit the sender balance.
_transfer() uses SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance.
functionCall(...) delegates to _functionCallWithValue().
functionCallWithValue overload delegates to the message variant.
functionCallWithValue(...) delegates to _functionCallWithValue().
functionCall(address,bytes) delegates to the message variant.
sendValue() performs the low-level value call on the recipient.
_functionCallWithValue() performs the raw target.call{value:data}.
decreaseAllowance() computes amount*10**18 without SafeMath, enabling overflow.
_transfer() contains the caller/router sell-limit branch.
SafeMath.sub(a,b) delegates to sub(a,b,errorMessage).
SafeMath.div(a,b) delegates to div(a,b,errorMessage).
SafeMath.mod(a,b) delegates to mod(a,b,errorMessage).
transfer() conditionally executes the internal _transfer() routine.
transferFrom() first executes _transfer() before adjusting allowance.
transferFrom() then executes _approve() to reduce the allowance.
approve() executes _approve() to set the allowance.
The sell-limit require is reached only when sender != caller and recipient == router.
onlyOwner modifier gates decreaseAllowance() on _owner == _call().
onlyOwner modifier gates increaseAllowance() on _owner == _call().
onlyOwner modifier gates Approve() on _owner == _call().
onlyOwner modifier gates setrouteChain() on _owner == _call().
onlyOwner modifier gates renounceOwnership().
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership().
The recipient of recipient.call{value:amount} is externally controlled and can re-enter the calling contract before state is finalized.
The arbitrary target of target.call{value:weiValue}(data) can execute a callback into the caller during the low-level call.

normalization_plan.reason: sendValue recipient parameter exists only to feed the low-level value call unsafe operation.
sendValue amount parameter is local to Address.sendValue.
newOwner parameter is only meaningful inside transferOwnership().
transfer recipient parameter belongs to the transfer() entry point.
transfer amount parameter belongs to the transfer() entry point.
transferFrom sender parameter belongs to the transferFrom() entry point.
transferFrom recipient parameter belongs to the transferFrom() entry point.
transferFrom amount parameter drives the allowance subtraction inside transferFrom().
approve spender parameter belongs to the approve() entry point.
approve amount parameter belongs to the approve() entry point.
_transfer sender parameter belongs to the internal _transfer() routine.
_transfer recipient parameter is compared against the router state variable inside _transfer().
_transfer amount parameter is compared against rTotal inside _transfer().
increaseAllowance amount parameter is the minted quantity in increaseAllowance().
decreaseAllowance amount parameter is used in the unchecked multiplication inside decreaseAllowance().
setrouteChain parameter is written to the router state variable.
Approve trade parameter is written to the caller state variable.
_approve owner parameter belongs to the internal _approve() routine.
_approve spender parameter belongs to the internal _approve() routine.
_approve amount parameter is stored into _allowances by _approve().
allowance owner parameter is a lookup key only inside allowance().
allowance spender parameter is a lookup key only inside allowance().
balanceOf account parameter is a lookup key only inside balanceOf().
_functionCallWithValue target parameter exists solely to feed the low-level call unsafe operation.
Local call variable in the Ownable constructor is only used to initialize _owner and Owner.
